arguments.message:
Hi! You can reduce the emails you receive by adjusting your personal notification settings.

1. Click your profile icon and choose **Profile → Notifications**.
2. Each notification type (assignment, mention, status change, digest, etc.) can be toggled on or off.
3. Keep the **Assignment** notifications on (so you only get alerts for items assigned to you) and turn off the other types.

These changes apply instantly to your account and don’t affect anyone else’s settings.
